instructions.title: HOW TO PLAY
instructions.body_1: Stop the pigs from waking the farmer with their flying food
instructions.body_2: Use the mouse to aim your sheep, click to launch
instructions.body_3: An alien will rebuild your haystack after each level
instructions.body_4: Watch out for the Super-Marrows, they destroy lots of hay bales!

pigs.title: Tip:
pigs.message: But the pigs are trying to wake him up with their food.

sheep.title: Tip:
sheep.message: Help the flock stop the naughty pigs!

get_ready.title: GET READY TO PLAY
get_ready.desc: Stop the Pigs from waking up the farmer by blocking the food! Use the mouse to aim and fire.
